Method of Attack: Backdoor account with hardcoded credentials allowing ransomware operators to encrypt NAS devices
Ransomware encrypting files in password-protected 7zip archives and demanding ransom
Discoverer: Ta-Lun Yen of TXOne IoT/ICS Security Research Labs
Impacted Systems: QNAP NAS devices running HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync
QNAP NAS devices running QTS 4.3.3, 4.3.4, 4.3.6 with HBS 3 versions v3.0.210506, v3.0.210507
QNAP NAS devices running QTS 4.5.x with HBS 3 v16.x (not affected)
Attack Vector: Improper access control vulnerability in HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync allowing privilege escalation and remote command execution
Backdoor account with hardcoded credentials in HBS 3 app
Indicators of Compromise: Ransomware payloads moving files into password-protected 7zip archives
